name: @huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete

one_liner.zh: 从 DSH 界面或 agent 工具彻底删除会话
one_liner.en: Delete DSH sessions from the UI or an agent tool

local: Uses DSH_HOME when set; otherwise uses ~/.dsh to locate session logs.

config_items.name: DSH_HOME
config_items.description: Overrides the DSH home directory used to locate session logs.

readme_mismatch: README says it works in web-shell-based clients generally; package.json declares dsh.client.platform as web, so broader client compatibility is not established by metadata.

completeness.reason: Implements UI and tool deletion paths, session storage cleanup, and post-delete refresh; no tests are present.

code.reason: Host deletion is split into helpers with input validation and response handling; client has localized UI and service fallbacks.

docs.reason: README includes install steps and describes the UI, confirmation, deletion, and agent tool.

maintenance.reason: The listed last push was 2026-08-14, outside the 30-day window.

tests.reason: The repository has no test files or CI workflow.
